mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library with a full moon tonight. The ISS is passing overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 59 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

City officials have issued a scam alert regarding planning and zoning application fees. Please remember the city does not accept online credit card or wire transfer payments. All fees must be paid by check and delivered to the city administration building on Lincoln Street. Also, residents should prepare for fall leaf pickup which begins on October 5.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to the Verona Fall Fest, live music at Bailey's Run, and live music at Lake Lou-ee.
In our weekly police report, on September 5, officers discovered multiple vehicles with slices of cheese on their windshields in what appears to be a viral social media prank.
Culver's is currently closed for a facility remodel, though they typically operate until 10:00 PM.
